title: Flashcards: Official languages, World
intro: Flip each card about the world. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: Which language is official in Germany?
cards.explain: German is the official language of Germany.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Algeria?
cards.explain: Arabic, French are official languages of Algeria.
